rules.name: Comparable history
rules.action: Exclude incompatible comparison; preserve original evidence and explain difference.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Evidence sufficiency
rules.when: too little confirmed comparable history under accepted policy
rules.action: No invented performance window or progression; request appropriate evidence.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Successful performance
rules.when: accepted success criteria met and current eligibility usable
rules.action: Propose only permitted field/increment within bounds; coach may retain current plan.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Task difficulty
rules.when: confirmed non-symptom difficulty under accepted ordinary-training policy
rules.action: Differentiate skill/load issue from logistics; no automatic diagnosis.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Symptoms or new restriction
rules.when: new/worsening report or active clinical restriction
rules.action: No progression or lighter-load workaround replaces appropriate clinical review.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Logistical non-completion
rules.when: travel, time, equipment or scheduling skip reported
rules.action: Not evidence of inability; no accumulated catch-up volume.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Adjusted-session history
rules.action: Separate original target, temporary adjustment and actuals; no automatic permanent baseline change.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Increment feasibility
rules.when: desired load conflicts with available increment or allowed limit
rules.action: Do not round beyond limit or transfer another lift's maximum.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Reassessment trigger
rules.action: Specify task, side, protocol and rationale; do not claim resolution.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Partial reassessment
rules.when: only subset of findings/sides explicitly reassessed
rules.action: Leave omitted or incomparable findings unresolved; cannot clear independent restrictions.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Weekly constraints
rules.when: coach confirms goals/days/budgets/kit/support and reviewed structure
rules.action: Compose only permitted slots with required patterns, full time and visible unmet needs.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Infeasible week
rules.when: required work cannot fit accepted constraints
rules.action: No extra day, invented equipment or unreviewed candidate inserted to hide shortfall.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Concurrent proposals
rules.when: R2 and R3 target same future occurrence
rules.action: Produce one explicitly reviewed revision; do not stack independent changes.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.

rules.name: Approval freshness
rules.when: plan/context/content version differs or server unavailable
rules.action: Block authority mutation; preserve history; same-key operation reconciliation.
rules.scope: adult supported task only; accepted clinical/content policy and coach approval remain required
rules.precedence: Clinical/session authority, source validity and hard constraints precede numerical/relevance proposals.
